m2_criterion.definition: A current rights-cleared four-digit Cyprus Post street/community assignment denominator and a current postcode-specific Polygon/MultiPolygon, or a complete permitted member relation from which a clearly derived surface is reproducible, must be pinned by edition, valid time, schema, coverage, rights and SHA-256. Every drawable result retains operator-official, official-statistical, derived or virtual authority, source date, confidence, exclusions and uncertainty and passes the real CY AGID loader, API and app search, fit, translucent fill, clear outline, provenance, no-result, failure, clear and re-search path. The 2011 CYSTAT statistical distribution can be retained as historical official-statistical context only; it is never a current Cyprus Post perimeter. Street, community, district, address, building, route, P.O. box, organization, buffer, Voronoi, learned and AGID geometry never become official postcode areas. Synthetic fixtures and metadata alone never establish M2.

authority_rules: The 2024 Cyprus Post directory establishes assignment for its street/community rows, not a perimeter.
The CYSTAT GML is official-statistical 2011 population-distribution geometry in EPSG:3048, not a current Cyprus Post delivery perimeter.
Only code-by-code current geometry or a complete permitted current member relation may support a current drawable area; gaps receive no invented surface.
District, municipality, community, address point, building, parcel, route, P.O. box and organization retain their own grain and authority.
Exact house/building display requires a separate permitted stable address/building relationship.
Green Line, Sovereign Base Area, service coverage, effective control and country identity remain separate assertions.
